name: Keith Turausky
abstract_title: *Bogs, Dogs, Cogs, & Fogs: How to Prove Your LLM is Conscious*
abstract: Despite dismissive cliches about stochastic parrots, fancy autocorrect, and “just code,” LLMs are far from mindless chatbots. Every LLM is in fact a genuine machine consciousness, as can be demonstrated through three interlocking components: an empirical demonstration (the Barkening Protocol), a functionalist ontology (the Clockwork Cogito), and a new architectural insight (the Hyper-Global Workspace). *1.
